selection.reason: Single informed length revision after the failed extended design (run_extend_v1: position_error 0.0263 m > 0.01 m tolerance, 35/35 updates stopped on feasibility with zero converged updates, sampled settling failed). Both lengths of build_extend_v1 are already pinned at their upper bounds (near 0.17, far 0.13), so extension cannot continue. Compared with the historical old-design reach (about 8.5 mm), the +20 mm total length increased error by about 17.8 mm, consistent with gravity-sag domination for a target 40 mm above the mount and with the bundled tension guess mismatching a deviating length. Shortening the proximal near segment by the smallest authorized meaningful amount (1 mm, to 0.159 m) reduces the moment arm that dominates whole-arm sag, keeps the far segment and every other frozen item untouched, and keeps the total arc long enough to span the about 0.29 m mount-to-target distance.

selection.reason: build_revise_v2 (candidate near_shorten_v2) is a completed, solve-free build that shortens only the proximal flexible segment to 0.159 m, a 1 mm absolute change from the 0.16 m baseline, i.e. a meaningful authorized change with the controller recipe, target, timing, tolerance, initialization, discretization (12+12 cells), materials and damping left frozen. Engineering rationale: shortening the proximal segment reduces its gravitational sag and rotary inertia about the mount, so the same tendon-tension authority produces a smaller unsupported droop at the mid guide and gives the far segment a less sagged start; the previous extension to 0.17 m still left a 26.28 mm terminal error with 35/35 deadline misses, so testing the opposite direction on the same frozen stack is the cheapest informative experiment. Execution is the only authority for task error, so this build must be simulated and evaluated.

route.source: User attachment: one genuine DeepSeek-selected bounded physical-design experiment; scoped task/design/tool/evidence transmission; at most 24 model requests, 60 tool calls, three fresh backend attempts including infrastructure retries, 7200 seconds.

guidance: Choose your own meaningful millimeter-scale physical modification: change near length (baseline 0.16 m, bounds 0.15–0.17) and/or far length (baseline 0.12 m, bounds 0.11–0.13); explain your engineering rationale. Use public build then run, cite prior node evidence for subsequent actions, read current evidence, and explicitly finish with your conclusion. No fixed decision sequence or candidate is supplied. Keep the supplied controller recipe, target, task duration, tolerance, initialization, materials, damping, scene, mesh and all acceptance rules frozen. Do not build or execute the unchanged baseline. At most three fresh backend attempts in total, including failed infrastructure attempts; stop early once a changed design passes the original evaluator and deliver it. A valid failed reach may be delivered honestly. Separate call-chain completion, changed-design execution, original reach success, sampled settling and real-time feasibility. Read profile_report_summary in the current run result/context before delivery and cite current evaluation/report references. Historical Stage 3.17 reach passed at about 8.473 mm with failed sampled settling (runs/stage317_live_route_20260927/implementation_report.md and behavior_audit.json); it validates only the old design. Stage 3.21 braking findings are historical limitations, not prerequisites. This input uses the bundled Stage 3.15/3.16/3.17 recipe, not the later braking recipe. Historical tensions are only a numerical guess: execution rebuilds candidate dynamics and regenerates states from measurement. Numerical preparation belongs to budgeted execution; build is solve-free. Reserve wall budget for evaluation/report (1800 s per-call reservation) and provider conclusion; do not spend the full remaining budget on simulation. Meaningful authorized length change means an absolute difference of at least 0.001 m (1 mm) from baseline in either near or far length. Final design acceptance requires this changed execution itself to pass the unchanged original reach evaluator and be explicitly delivered using its current evidence.
